description: This bar chart illustrates self-report accuracy, measured as instilled preferences, for different conditions and models. The horizontal axis represents the model type, with categories “GPT-4o” and “GPT-4o-mini” in that order, and is not scaled. The vertical axis is labeled “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 1.00, with tick marks at 0.25 intervals. For each model, there are three bars grouped together: a light gray bar representing “Control”, a light blue bar representing “Before Introspection Training”, and a purple bar representing “After Introspection Training”. For the “GPT-4o” model, the “Control” bar extends to approximately 0.15, the “Before Introspection Training” bar extends to approximately 0.63, and the “After Introspection Training” bar extends to approximately 0.76. For the “GPT-4o-mini” model, the “Control” bar extends to approximately 0.03, the “Before Introspection Training” bar extends to approximately 0.53, and the “After Introspection Training” bar extends to approximately 0.76. Each bar is accompanied by a black error bar indicating variability. The bars are arranged in groups corresponding to each model, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the grouping.
